widgets_values: A single continuous cinematic 12-second LTX-2.3 PromptRelay multi-reference image-to-video shot. Use the provided reference images as visual anchors for identity, outfit, style, color palette, and environment, while keeping one coherent main subject and a stable composition. Preserve reference consistency, avoid mixing extra characters, use soft cinematic lighting, controlled motion, VVR temporal stability, IC LoRA guidance, no subtitles, no text overlays.

[0-3s] The first moment establishes the main subject and environment using the reference images as stable visual anchors, without adding new props or extra characters.

|
[3-6s] The subject makes a small natural movement, such as a blink, slight head turn, or restrained hand adjustment, while the reference-based outfit and style remain consistent.

|
[6-9s] The camera drifts slowly to reveal a little more depth in the scene, preserving the color palette, lighting direction, and identity from the references.

|
[9-12s] The motion settles into a clean final composition, with stable details and no identity blending artifacts.

smart_prompt:
Scene 1:
The scene opens inside an enchanted glass greenhouse hidden in a deep forest. Tall glass walls, a glowing glass ceiling, lush plants, flowers, moss, and climbing vines fill the space. Warm golden sunlight pours through the greenhouse, and volumetric light rays move gently through drifting dust and magical particles. Leaves and flower petals sway softly in the air, establishing a sacred, immersive, living fantasy environment.

Scene 2:
A beautiful elf-like young woman steps gracefully into the center of the greenhouse as the main subject. Her long flowing hair and elegant fantasy clothing move softly in the warm air. She slowly lifts one hand toward the light, her expression calm and mysterious, as if awakening the magic of the place. The camera makes a gentle push-in, drawing attention to her presence and emotional connection to the environment.

Scene 3:
A glowing green life-seed begins to rise and float in front of the elf girl. It rotates slowly at first, then brightens and opens slightly like a living magical crystal bud. Soft green energy ripples outward from it, and tiny glowing particles spiral around her hand and body. The elf girl reaches toward the life-seed, and the seed responds to her touch, creating a visible bond between the girl, the light, and the greenhouse.

Scene 4:
A luminous spirit deer appears beside the elf girl, stepping out from the glowing mist and filtered sunlight. Its translucent mint-green body sparkles with magical particles. It circles around the girl and the floating life-seed with elegant, gentle movement, then lifts slightly in a graceful, deer-like leap. The deer reacts to the life-seed’s energy, as if drawn to it, strengthening the magical interaction between all three elements.

Scene 5:
The elf girl extends both hands toward the life-seed, and the magical core releases a stronger wave of green light. Vines, leaves, petals, and floating motes respond to the energy, swirling gently around the girl and the deer. The spirit deer raises its head and steps closer, bathed in the green glow, while the camera slowly arcs around them to reveal the full magical relationship: the girl guiding the power, the seed radiating life, and the deer harmonizing with the energy.

Scene 6:
All elements merge into one unified cinematic fantasy moment. The enchanted greenhouse glows with warm sunlight and magical green reflections. The elf girl stands at the center as the guardian of the space, the life-seed floats near her as the radiant magical core, and the spirit deer stays close beside her as a sacred companion. Hair, fabric, vines, petals, light particles, and energy trails all move together in a harmonious, dynamic composition. The final image feels alive, immersive, emotional, and magical, not static, not collage-like, but like one complete fantasy story frozen at its most beautiful moment.
